name: Hakkoz
overview: Hakkoz is identified in Scripture as a priestly figure connected to the family line of Koz, as seen in Ezra 2:61 where the children of Koz are mentioned among the descendants of the priests. The name Koz appears again in Nehemiah 3:4 and 3:21, highlighting Meremoth, son of Urijah, son of Koz, who played a role in the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls. These passages emphasize Hakkoz's priestly lineage and the faithful service of his descendants in the post-exilic community, reflecting the continuity of God's covenant people centered on worship and restoration.
